independent_oracle: original/hepta-hia-program-tools.py.txt is the complete exact acffa file; retain and compare the original function AST, not a newly handwritten reference algorithm.
oracle_method: Execute the original function with independent reset fixtures and compare full values, exception/cause/context identities and ordered foreign observations. Real Linux files are additional controls; stubs alone cannot establish filesystem behavior.

proposed_case_groups.requirement: Actual regular files at 0, 8MiB-1, 8MiB, 8MiB+1, default/zero/explicit smaller limits; compare bytes or full original exception metadata.
Actual str and Path, bytes and invalid PathLike, embedded NUL, missing path, missing parent, permission failure under a documented non-root UID; compare Path-before-catch priority.
Actual final symlink, parent symlink, hard link, directory, FIFO with writer absent, socket where supported; preserve accepted parent symlink/hard link and bounded nonblocking rejection.
Actual file truncation and growth immediately after the real fstat. Preserve original non-snapshot behavior and close-before-final-length check.
Instrument O_RDONLY/getattr/bit-or observations and exceptions; require exact original trace, no eagerly bound later operations.
Mutate fdopen/open bindings during lookup/calls; require fdopen binding before inner open and original leak/ownership behavior on fdopen failure.
Observe __enter__/__exit__ special lookup, return value, body exception, close exception, suppression, sys.exception and nested context chains on each supported interpreter.
Instrument fstat lookup, fileno lookup/call, S_ISREG binding, st_mode property and truth callback; later st_size/limit must remain unobserved on nonregular refusal.
Custom > and truth objects, __add__, __index__, bool, float, negative/huge explicit limit, and adversarial callbacks; no host int coercion or new profile rejection.
Bind read before limit+1; return a custom payload, track close before len/comparison, and require original returned object identity.

OSError at every effect, foreign BaseException, close replacement, class constructor failure, callback mutation of cause/context, and same exception object reuse; compare observable trace and raw chain descriptors.
Context suppresses each pre-payload body error. Compare target-generated UnboundLocalError class, args, ambient context and no later read.
Use weakrefs/finalizers and temporary callbacks to expose retention-order changes. Treat differences as implementation failures; do not shrink supported input domain to pass.

Use an actual generated/compiled native entry, not a fake return buffer. Retain r1 and r2 bridge bytes with the same unchanged HIA source/image. Reproduce a real conversion terminal (kind 3) and count actual HIAEditRejected constructor invocations: r1 repeated finish/finish-after-close may replay; r2 must permit at most one. Record actual old observations rather than assuming the predicted replay. Also cover malformed ACK, successful payload, unconsumed finish, entry-after-return and accounting BaseException; compare original exception object, traceback tail and raw context/cause metadata.
Interrupt the actual native path during an active context and ensure close happens once, never replaying a stale read or open. Preserve original foreign exception identity/tail/context.
Warm selection with mapped image, mutate source before identity computation and during operation, then actual current-source readmission and strict manifest refusal controls.

Build the real wheel; install in a new private prefix; execute -I -S -B with empty PATH and old read_bounded body instrumented to fail. Verify actual packaged source/image identities and exact file behavior.

Load the exact eight existing HIAProgramToolsTests methods without filtering, record loaded/executed ordered IDs, zero skips/errors/failures/expected-failures/unexpected-successes and old-owner zero use.
Scan every Python member of the frozen source tree for imports, aliases and calls; include all original discovered callers rather than asserting the six currently observed files are exhaustive.

Exercise ordinary 15-action native CLI and standalone reference-tool callers with the selected reader and existing 3/5-second assertions unchanged; preserve complete existing method denominators and raw outputs.

Build from a fresh matching cold report, reject missing/stale/mixed source-image identity, re-read all manifest/image/build/receipt bytes before and after; no development selector may satisfy strict mode.
